title: Converge From Spread
description: Các ký tự đứng cách xa nhau rồi dồn về giữa, ký tự ở giữa về trước, hai đầu về sau.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-converge-from-spread, written here): Split chars; char i starts at x = 150 px × (i − n/2) (demo 1.5 em × (i − (n−1)/2)) and moves to 0 over 1 s power1.inOut, stagger 80 ms from the centre outward (demo capped 0.6 s total), from 0.3 s; demo opacity 0.35 → 1. Loop exit: chars spread out again, edges first, 0.65 s, 40 ms apart, from 2.6 s; loop 3.5 s. Clip to the text box. Params: spread: khoảng cách đầu mỗi bậc (150 px) · duration (1 s) · stagger: từ giữa ra (0.08 s) · ease (power1.inOut).
